BUG-1918 refuses approvals from the session that claimed or implemented the work, and the old session's Agent-tool fixers share its session identity (lease 01a14243aa45 etc.). So the OLD session cannot approve: #2685 (BUG-2163), #2686 (BUG-2160/2161), #2687 (STORY-1698), #2688 (BUG-2139), #2689 (BUG-2157/2158), STORY-1699 and TASK-1787. YOU (an independent session) must record those verdicts.
Ready to record now: #2686 is APPROVED by an independent reviewer (round 2 at 850f91d797; base-only main merge 9c7ba29c81 with an empty remerge-diff; the reviewer report says the survivor skip requires PPid plus exe dev/ino, fails closed, and the CLONE_PARENT test bites). Record: aida review record BUG-2160 --pr 2686 --sha $(gh pr view 2686 --json headRefOid -q .headRefOid) --branch bug-2160-2161-deflake --verdict approved --summary '...'. Then 'aida merge-hold auto-release 2686', then ship.
#2687 (mandate): the adversarial review found B1-B5. The rulings are in the old session's message to the fixer: validate on load, 0600, monotonic stop, honest trust-boundary docs, B2 accepted risk, B3 exclusion ledger, B4 refuse a missing marker plus re-arm on all errors, B5 Decide always human; CI audit-doc regen. The fixer is working; you re-review.
subject: IMPORTANT for the new advisor: you must record approvals for PRs the old session's fixers built
